### No Success Without Wisdom
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-7-8-2012.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 10:10
Points:
- Contemporary culture is obsessed with talking about and pursuing success.
- Secular discussions and media almost entirely ignore the necessity of wisdom.
- Living wisely may not guarantee wealth, fame, or corporate status.
- Genuine success is defined by God rather than the world's standards.
